summary: Bounded Host premerge freshness and transient GitHub JSON-read reliability, without relaxing the independent Host signature, immutable SHA/CAS, branch protection, or fail-closed publication rules.

components.owning_subsystem: Independent Host premerge evidence verifier and read-only GitHub authority checks
components.disposition: REUSE existing independent Host authority; only increase SHA/CAS-bound signed snapshot freshness to 900 seconds and retry malformed read-only GitHub JSON once.
evidence: Existing 90-second snapshot timeout failed after legitimate slow remote API checks; user explicitly requested a longer bounded window.
Live PR86 publisher reported github_response_invalid after a valid signed snapshot; malformed JSON reads now receive one bounded read-only retry.
140 related unit tests passed, including expired/future timestamp and final recheck boundaries, malformed JSON retry and fail-closed behavior; Ruff and Pyright passed.
components.verification_level: Relevant Host verifier/publisher/issuer pytest 140 passed; Ruff passed; Pyright 0 errors; remote CI and independent security review still required before integration.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: The Host remains sole signer; models cannot grant merge authority. Signature, immutable main/head SHA, Lane/Queue CAS, remote CI, protection and live rechecks remain mandatory. Malformed reads fail closed after two attempts.
components.rollback_route: Revert the exact verifier and test changes and restore the previous trusted Host installation; no persisted data migration.

g1.necessity: Remote GitHub checks may exceed 90 seconds despite unchanged exact signed candidate identity; a bounded 15-minute window avoids redundant admin authentication and signature issuance.
